subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR establish the public `sessions.activity` / `session.activity` / plugin-hook contract now, or should those surfaces wait for the canonical per-session activity and attention-state design?
rationale: The implementation defines new Gateway protocol and plugin SDK contracts while the canonical activity issue still has unsettled semantics for attention state, stale runs, child rollups, and resync behavior.

options.title: Repair and align the public contract
options.body: Fix scoping and conflicts, then make the RPC/event/hooks match maintainer-approved activity semantics before merge.

options.title: Land only a narrower UI slice
options.body: Keep the chat running-work UI work but remove or defer public plugin/protocol hooks that are not yet accepted.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Leave this PR open or close it in favor of the broader design if maintainers do not want this branch to define the API.

recommendation.title: Repair and align the public contract
recommendation.body: Fix scoping and conflicts, then make the RPC/event/hooks match maintainer-approved activity semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the strongest current signal on the canonical Gateway activity-contract issue and has adjacent Gateway/protocol history.
